notes: Completes the multi-PC document and Aadhaar fix. In 1.0.3 the school's encryption key was only shared the first time the app happened to need it, so a PC that was updated but did not open a document never shared it and the other PCs kept failing. The keys are now shared as soon as the app opens on the PC that can read the records, there is a button to do it deliberately, and the one-time transfer to a shared database shares them too.
